name: Early Admission to First Grade Recommendation
description: After the District assesses a child for whom early admission to first grade is requested, the Director reviews the results and recommends to the Superintendent whether to approve.

preparers.name: Director of Student Services or designee

deadline: Parent request due by April 30 of the preceding school year
quote: The Director of Student Services or designee will review the results of the assessment and make a recommendation to the Superintendent regarding whether to approve the request.
